`solve_model` passes the current `n.snapshots` through `_as_model_snapshots`, rather than obtaining snapshots from the built model. If a model is built with flat multi-period snapshots and the network’s snapshots are subsequently changed to a single-level index, that helper leaves the single-level index unchanged, so the callback receives a different representation from the model’s tuple-labelled snapshot index.
